title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:
The incident title describes a lawyer in Minnesota being suspended in connection with fake case citations attributed to AI use. This fits a documented failure pattern in which a generative AI system produces plausible-looking but fabricated legal citations, and a practitioner submits them to a court without independently verifying that the cases exist.

The failure occurs at the point of human use rather than at the model's training or deployment stage. A verification step, checking each cited case against an authoritative legal database before filing, would have been sufficient to catch the problem before it reached a court.

What the underlying AI system was, how the citations were generated, and the precise grounds for the suspension are not established from the available source, as the article text was not recoverable.
